labelNp.value: Now Playing Overlay (song info on screen)

npEnabled.text: Show now-playing overlay (album art, title and artist on screen)

npUnlock.text: Unlock to drag (drag it into place, then untick to lock it; mouse stirring pauses while unlocked)

npMirror.text: Mirror layout (cover on the right, text right-aligned)

npMaxWidth.text: Overlay max width (% of screen width, 100 = full width; longer titles scroll, shorter ones stay still)

npScrim.text: Backing panel darkness (helps text stand out, 0 = none)

npFont.text: Extra font (optional): an installed font name, e.g. Spotify Mix, or a .ttf / .otf / .woff2 file name placed in the wallpaper's fonts folder, e.g. MyFont.ttf

monitorCount.text: Number of monitors (Auto-detect works it out from the screen shape)

monitorLayout.text: Monitor layout (optional: leave blank to auto-detect. Only fill in for mixed-size monitors, left to right as WIDTHxHEIGHT@scaling%, e.g. 2560x1440@125, 1920x1080@100)

perMonitor.text: Separate waves per monitor (needs Lively Span layout)

overscan.text: Room off-screen (%) (extra fluid area past every screen edge so waves can drift off instead of piling up; higher uses more GPU, 0 = off)

wavesFrom.text: Waves start on (the other monitor receives them: streaks cross over and spread out where they land)

monSizeFollow.text: Wave size follows each monitor's size (100 = waves scale to each screen, 0 = same size on every monitor; needs the Monitor layout filled in)

fireworks.text: Firework bursts (higher = bursts spread out, open up in a ring and clear space in intense parts; 0 = old behaviour)

instrumentTrack.text: Instrument tracking (each instrument makes its own waves, off = bass only)

waveSpeed.text: Wave speed (how fast and strong the waves move)

bassCutoff.text: Bass range (lower = deep bass only, used when instrument tracking is off)

intensityImpact.text: Song intensity (waves grow in big moments, 0 = off)

fadeHold.text: End-of-song fade (how long waves linger, 0 = off)

noteTravel.text: Low-note trails (bass leaves longer trails, 0 = off)

cursorInfluence.text: Mouse stirring (how much your cursor moves the waves, 0 = off)

colorOverride.text: Color override (use your own colors instead of album art)

defaultColor1.text: Color 1 (your color, also used when there is no album art)

defaultColor2.text: Color 2 (your color, also used when there is no album art)

twoToneBalance.text: Two-color balance (left = more Color 2, right = more Color 1)

americaMode.text: America mode (art that is only red and blue becomes a flag mix: red 41.5% / white 36.9% / blue 21.5%)

americaWhiteRate.text: America mode: white on drums + bass (0 = all red, higher = white takes over more of their hits)

fireMode.text: Fireplace mode (art that is only yellow / orange becomes fire: each wave is born hot yellow and cools to orange, then red)

neonBoost.text: Neon boost (albums with neon colors keep their punch: saturation is restored and glowing cores stay colored instead of washing to white, 0 = off)

fireYellow.text: Fireplace: yellow limit (higher = warmer fire with less yellow, 0 = off)

primaryLean.text: Primary color (the album's main color leads the mood)

primaryStrength.text: Primary color strength (how much the waves use the main color)

densityDiffusion.text: Density Diffusion (how fast color fades out)

velocityDiffusion.text: Velocity Diffusion (how fast motion slows down)

pressure.text: Pressure (how strongly waves push each other apart)

splatRadius.text: Splat Radius (size of each color burst)

bloomThreshold.text: Bloom Threshold (how bright before it glows, lower = more glow)

backgroundColor.text: Background color (solid color behind the waves)

backgroundSrc.text: Background image or video (from the wallpapers folder)

backgroundFit.text: Background fit (how the image fills the screen)
